ios.desc:
"MynaApp," provided by the Digital Agency, is an application that enables identity verification using My Number Card and the addition of My Number Card functionality to smartphones.
Starting in the summer of 2026, the "Mynaportal App" was updated and integrated with the features of the "Digital Identification App" and is now offered as "MynaApp."

■ Key Features
1. Identity Verification and Information Linkage with My Number Card
Users can perform authentication and signing using My Number Card (physical card and smartphone), as well as share information such as name, for services provided by government agencies and private businesses.

2. Setting Up Smartphone My Number Card
Users can set up "My Number Card on iPhone," which allows them to carry the functionality of their My Number Card within their iPhone.

3. Receiving Push Notifications of Notices from Government Agencies
Users can receive push notifications for notices from government agencies and other organizations delivered to Mynaportal.

quotes.text:
Japan has a government ID card (MyNumber) with a digital certificate which can be scanned using NFC on your phone to log into do taxes online, check on your medical insurance details (like what charges have been made and your prescriptions), and pension information. It can also be scanned via NFC to apply for financial services like credit cards/bank accounts online.
